tools.name: smsto_list_messages
tools.description: Read one page of the SMS.to messages on the account: recipient, text, sender, status, cost and callback URL. Free. GET /v2/messages.

tools.name: smsto_get_message
tools.description: Read one SMS.to message by its id: recipient, text, status, cost and send time. Free. GET /message/{id}.

tools.name: smsto_list_campaigns
tools.description: Read one page of the SMS.to campaigns (bulk sends) on the account: text, sender, status, message counts and cost. Free. GET /v2/campaigns.

tools.name: smsto_estimate_sms
tools.description: Read-only: estimate the SMS count and cost of one message to one recipient before sending. It sends nothing and bills nothing. POST /sms/estimate.

tools.name: smsto_send_sms
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS A REAL SMS AND BILLS THE ACCOUNT: send one SMS to one recipient. A sent message cannot be recalled. Before calling, show the user the sender, recipient and exact text and get their confirmation. Run smsto_estimate_sms first to show the cost. The recipient must have consented to receive

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "smsto_send_sms" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: WRITE, SENDS A REAL SMS AND BILLS THE ACCOUNT: send one SMS to one recipient. A sent message cannot be recalled. Before calling, show the user the sender, recip…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smsto_list_messages, smsto_get_message, smsto_list_campaigns, smsto_estimate_sms, smsto_send_sms · Public sink: smsto_list_messages, smsto_get_message, smsto_list_campaigns, smsto_estimate_sms, smsto_send_sms · Destructive: smsto_send_sms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smsto_list_messages, smsto_get_message, smsto_list_campaigns, smsto_estimate_sms, smsto_send_sms · Public sink: smsto_list_messages, smsto_get_message, smsto_list_campaigns, smsto_estimate_sms, smsto_send_sms · Destructive: smsto_send_sms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
